project_info.theme: Quiet bouquet portrait beside a passing train at night
project_info.color_palette: dark charcoal, steel gray, muted blue, dim platform light, floral accents

main_subject.detail: A woman with long wavy blonde bob hair stands on a night-time train-station or subway platform. She wears a long dark trench coat and holds a bouquet of flowers; wind from the moving train softly moves her hair and coat fabric.
main_subject.style: dark cinematic realism with a poetic editorial tone

items: woman standing on a subway platform with her body slightly turned away
face looking directly toward the camera or a rear three-quarter interpretation preserving the quiet glance
bouquet held visibly in her hands
fast-passing train behind her creates strong horizontal motion blur
platform structure recedes into darkness with quiet cinematic depth

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: low platform light with deep shadows
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: subdued illumination on figure and bouquet, contrasting with train motion blur
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: moody, poetic, reflective, and quietly intense

technical_specs.render_style: cinematic realism with motion blur and film grain
technical_specs.color_treatment: muted colors, deep blacks, soft film texture, restrained contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a dark cinematic scene on a moving-train station or subway platform at night. A woman stands on the platform with her body slightly turned away while her face looks directly toward the camera; alternatively use a rear three-quarter view that preserves the same quiet, reflective glance. She has long wavy blonde bob hair gently moved by the wind and wears a long dark trench coat. A train passes fast behind her, creating strong motion blur, while the wind softly moves her hair and coat fabric. She holds a bouquet of flowers in her hands. Give her a calm, reflective, slightly melancholic expression and make the atmosphere moody and poetic. Use low light, deep shadows, muted colors, cinematic realism, a slow emotional moment, film grain, and quiet intensity.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, preserve the face reference's facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the blonde bob, dark trench coat, bouquet, platform, passing-train motion blur, wind movement, and quiet night mood. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: face-reference
assets.usage: Maintain facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.
